notes.title: The Astral Flux Playtest is live!
notes.notes:
We're good to go! We've let the first batch of participants in, and you should now be seeing “Astral Flux Playtest” in your library.

For existing players, you can access the new world directly from the “Elevated” title screen menu item. If you’re new to the game–or would like to level up a bit first–you can use the “Start” menu item to play one of the existing worlds first. In either case, you will be required to play the tutorial first if you’ve never played it.

We'll mainly be gathering feedback in the Cosmocat Discord (#astral-flux channel), but we will check this thread occasionally as well as post critical information here.

A webpage will also pop-up when you exit the game; it provides both a quick form for entering feedback, as well as a direct link to the Discord community. (You can also find a link on the title screen, and in the pause menu.)

We’ll leave the playtest live for a couple of weeks and will push additional builds as needed.

Thanks for your help, and happy playtesting!
